parsed.reason: The message states facts flatly with no attribution to any look Hale already took. It opens with "Great news!" and delivers multiple facts (Sunnyside Splash Pad details, Beaches Rec Centre program, Maya's routine visit reminder, registration timing) without any first-person verb of finding or checking in the lead sentence. There is no "I found," "I checked," "I looked up," or similar attribution that would signal Hale reporting back on work already done. The facts arrive as disconnected pieces of information, indistinguishable from trivia a stranger might send. The closing offer to "keep an eye on all of this" comes too late and as a forward-looking proposal rather than an attribution for the facts already stated.
